notes.claim: In polar form, to multiply you multiply the moduli and add the arguments.
To divide in polar form, you divide the moduli and subtract the arguments.
Multiplication and division are most easily done in polar form, while addition and subtraction are easier in Cartesian form.
A complex number r∠θ can also be written in exponential form re^(jθ), with θ in radians.

sources.title: 10.2 — University of Sheffield
sources.quote: We conclude that addition and subtraction are most easily carried out in Cartesian form whereas multiplication and division are most easily carried out in polar form.
